scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm typegen && pnpm db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm typegen && pnpm db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.test:eval: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .dev.vars ] && . ./.dev.vars; EVAL=1 exec vitest run test/parser/eval.live.test.ts'
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tack-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply tack-prod --env production --remote
